title: SG-7.4 · Write a structured execution report after each worker run
summary: Worker writes a structured execution report to development/executions after every run, whatever the outcome, with the execution ID validated like the state store
description: Context: backend/worker/internal/runner.Runner.Run persists only a store.Execution record under .storyforge/executions and writes no report. Desired behavior: after every run that took the lock, a JSON report is written to development/executions/<id>.json. Success, failure and awaiting-approval all produce one. The ID is validated by the same rule as store.Store. Expected result: reviewable, committed execution summaries. Why: the product requires persisted structured execution reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a run that fails, succeeds or awaits approval, When Run returns, Then <ReportDir>/<id>.json exists with the final status
Given an execution ID such as ../evil, When a report is written, Then it is rejected with store.ErrInvalidID and no file is created outside ReportDir

in_scope: Export of the store ID validator

technical_constraints: No database; plain JSON files written atomically
definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and verified by unit tests
non_functional: Atomic writes via temp file and rename
